title: Hula 7000 Menthol Prefilled Vape Pod + Refill
description: The Hula 7000 Menthol prefilled pod delivers a clean, crisp vape with an unmistakably fresh and cooling sensation. The smooth inhale is infused with icy mint notes that develop into a brisk, refreshing exhale, leaving behind a cooling effect that lingers long after each puff. These Hula Prefilled Replacement Pods are designed for use with the Hula Prefilled Pod System Kit, offering a quick and convenient way to replace or swap flavours without the need for refilling or coil changes. Each pod contains 12ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, with a 2ml draw-activated pod that is automatically topped up by a built-in 10ml refill reservoir. Delivering up to 7000 puffs (approx.), these pods feature dual mesh coil technology for consistently smooth flavour and vapour. Simply insert the pod into your Hula device, and enjoy long-lasting performance with minimal fuss. Available in 10 satisfying flavours, these replacement pods are perfect for keeping your vape fresh and flavourful.
